name: watercolor-basics
description:
Teaches beginner watercolor painting techniques: wet-on-wet and wet-on-dry
application methods, flat, graded, and variegated washes, value studies
using a single color, color mixing fundamentals, and common mistake
prevention. Includes a materials checklist and a technique sequence
building from basic washes to a first complete painting. Use when the
user wants to start watercolor painting, asks about wash techniques,
watercolor materials, or color mixing with watercolors. Do NOT use for
drawing fundamentals (use drawing-fundamentals-beginner), oil or acrylic
painting techniques, or professional illustration.
